title: Mica under the Teotihuacan pyramids as technology

tellings.quote: Why did they have huge sheets of micica brought to Teaot Wakan Sun per pyramid from two to three thousand miles away in South America

plain: A guest named Jim Weiner asks Michels why huge sheets of mica, a thin, flaky mineral, were carried to the Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan in Mexico from two to three thousand miles away in South America. He suggests the mica must have been there to do something, as a kind of technology. He offers it as his own question and names no source.
